flowchart LR
    subgraph DEV[Developer]
        REPO[Source repo]
        GIT[git push]
    end

    subgraph CI[GitHub Actions]
        TST[Lint + tests]
        IMG[Docker image]
    end

    subgraph RUN[Docker Compose]
        API[FastAPI port 8000]
        UI[Streamlit port 8501]
        VOL[(Chroma + BM25 vol)]
    end

    subgraph USR[User]
        BR[Browser]
    end

    REPO --> GIT --> TST --> IMG --> API
    IMG --> UI
    API --- VOL
    BR --> UI
    UI -. REST .-> API

    style DEV fill:#EBF5FB,stroke:#2980B9
    style CI fill:#FEF9E7,stroke:#F1C40F
    style RUN fill:#E8F8F5,stroke:#1ABC9C
    style USR fill:#F5EEF8,stroke:#8E44AD
